reason: 该插件的核心面向用户功能是在 DSH Web 页面右下角以卡片方式展示额度余额、今日消耗估算与峰谷状态，并提供重置配置，因此主要用途是 Web 界面面板监测展示。

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的插件，在页面右下角显示余额、今日消耗估算和峰谷计价状态，并可按设置调整每日重置时间。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that shows balance, estimated daily consumption, and peak/valley pricing status in a corner panel with configurable daily reset timing.

capabilities: Fetches balance data from DeepSeek official API with an API key.
Displays a real-time web UI card with balance, daily usage estimate, and peak/valley pricing state.
Provides install/uninstall support through DSH plugin profile bundling and supports temporary dynamic loading.
Supports configurable daily reset timing for local usage estimation.

reasons.code: README 说明该插件在 DSH Web 页面右下角显示额度小仪表，并包含“余额、今日已消耗、峰谷计价”信息。
README 指出通过 GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance 获取余额，使用 Authorization: Bearer <API Key>。
README 说明可通过 dsh plugin 进行安装/卸载，且支持临时动态插件运行方式。
